config.skysterrainsmoother.enabled.toolt: Smooth new dry Overworld slopes and cave floors. Turning this off also stops the separate Grass Slabs pass. Existing chunks stay unchanged. Restart Minecraft.
config.skysterrainsmoother.smoothingLeve: 1: slabs. 2: slabs and steps. 3: slabs, steps and corners. Missing shapes use a slab only where it fits safely. Restart Minecraft.
config.skysterrainsmoother.enableMineral: Use available natural Mineralogy rock slabs when the mod is installed. Disabled slab types are skipped. Restart Minecraft.
config.skysterrainsmoother.materials.too: Choose which material families can be smoothed. Applies to new slopes and cave floors. Restart Minecraft.
config.skysterrainsmoother.compatibility: Choose optional mod support. Applies to new slopes and cave floors. Restart Minecraft.
config.skysterrainsmoother.materials.soi: Smooth registered grass and dirt terrain. The Grass Slabs grass-generation switch still applies. Applies to new slopes and cave floors. Restart Minecraft.
config.skysterrainsmoother.materials.san: Smooth sand, red sand and gravel. Applies to new slopes and cave floors. Restart Minecraft.
config.skysterrainsmoother.materials.sto: Smooth stone, sandstone, terracotta and modded rocks, including Mineralogy and BOP. Applies to new slopes and cave floors. Restart Minecraft.
config.skysterrainsmoother.materials.sno: Smooth snow blocks and powder snow. Snowy grass appearance is controlled separately by the terrain. Applies to new slopes and cave floors. Restart Minecraft.
config.skysterrainsmoother.materials.ice: Smooth registered ice terrain, including packed ice. Applies to new slopes and cave floors. Restart Minecraft.
config.skysterrainsmoother.materials.oth: Smooth add-on materials not assigned to another group. Applies to new slopes and cave floors. Restart Minecraft.
